column1: What JavaScript method creates deeply immutable objects where properties cannot be added, removed, or modified?
column2: Object.freeze()

column1: Why is Object.freeze() shallow by default in JavaScript?
column2: It only freezes the immediate properties of the object; nested objects or arrays remain mutable unless recursively frozen.

column1: How is currency formatted to Nigerian Naira (NGN) without decimals using modern Web APIs?
column2: new Intl.NumberFormat('en-NG', { style: 'currency', currency: 'NGN', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(value)

column1: What is the difference between the 'input' and 'change' events on an <input type="range"> slider?
column2: The 'input' event fires continuously as the user drags the thumb, whereas 'change' only fires when the user releases the thumb or commits the value.

column1: Why should event delegation be preferred over attaching separate 'input' listeners to multiple form fields?
column2: It attaches a single listener on an ancestor element (or document), reducing memory footprint and automatically handling dynamically rendered inputs.

column1: How is volume discount calculated from tiered threshold arrays in PRICING_MODEL?
column2: Iterating through tiers sorted by descending minQty and selecting the rate for the first tier where current quantity >= minQty.

column1: What formula calculates total price with an optional rush turnaround surcharge?
column2: finalTotal = Math.round((subtotal - discountAmount) * (isRush ? 1.25 : 1.0))

column1: What ARIA attribute ensures assistive technologies announce dynamic price changes when the total updates?
column2: aria-live="polite"

column1: Why is type="button" mandatory on non-submitting <button> elements inside a <form>?
column2: In HTML5, the default button type inside a form is 'submit', which would trigger form submission and page reloads on click.

column1: How do synchronized range slider and number input fields stay in step during bidirectional user input?
column2: The 'input' event listener reads target.value and updates the sibling control's .value property before dispatching the state recalculation.

column1: What CSS property controls the tint color of native range sliders, checkboxes, and radio buttons?
column2: accent-color: var(--color-primary);

column1: What CSS display property allows the summary card to stick during scrolling while remaining in document flow?
column2: position: sticky; top: 90px;

column1: What CSS selector pseudoclass applies focus rings strictly for keyboard users while suppressing them on mouse clicks?
column2: :focus-visible

column1: How is a custom radio pill styled to reflect its checked state cleanly in CSS?
column2: Using the hidden input with label styling or checking radio.checked in JavaScript to toggle an .active class on the label container.

column1: Why should encodeURIComponent() be used when building WhatsApp URL query strings?
column2: It converts spaces and special characters (newlines, colons, bullets, currency symbols) into RFC 3986 percent-encoded strings (%20, %0A, %E2%82%A6).

column1: What HTML5 attribute groups a set of related radio buttons together so only one can be checked at a time?
column2: The name attribute (e.g., name="calc-turnaround").

column1: How does dataset property mapping connect HTML markup to JavaScript event handling?
column2: Data attributes like data-action="calc-select-product" and data-product-id="brochures" are read via event.target.closest('[data-action]').dataset.

column1: Why is Math.round() or Math.floor() necessary when computing currency discounts in JavaScript?
column2: Floating-point arithmetic in JavaScript can produce tiny decimal imprecisions (e.g., 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004); rounding ensures exact integer currency values.

column1: What is the purpose of role="radiogroup" on a dynamic pill options container?
column2: It communicates to assistive screen readers that the group of custom pills represents a mutually exclusive set of choices.

column1: What DOM property on input elements defines the minimum allowable numerical value?
column2: The min attribute (e.g., min="100").

column1: What DOM property on input elements defines the granularity of allowable value increments?
column2: The step attribute (e.g., step="50").

column1: Why is rel="noopener noreferrer" essential when opening WhatsApp links with target="_blank"?
column2: It prevents the opened page from accessing window.opener (avoiding tabnabbing security vulnerabilities) and omits the Referer HTTP header.
